description: Full-stack performance optimization with measured proof. Six-layer audit (database, API, edge proxy, client data layer, rendering, browser resources), immutable labeled baselines, deterministic before/after captures via the perf-harness extension (EXPLAIN medians, p50/p95 loops, wire bytes, ETag replay, Lighthouse, Playwright interaction probes, pg_stat_statements discovery), an auto-built dashboard, and a one-concern-per-commit fix loop. /creo perf init scaffolds everything for a project. Trigger keywords: performance, slow page, latency, benchmark, baseline, EXPLAIN, query plan, index, N+1, bundle size, Lighthouse, Core Web Vitals, p95, payload, compression, ETag, profiling.
